summary: Enhance your understanding of World Bank procurement with our specialized course. Learn to manage equipment and services procurement efficiently and effectively
lede: Effective procurement strategies for World Bank-financed projects help teams turn project needs into well-planned packages, choose fit-for-purpose sourcing approaches, evaluate submissions consistently, and maintain a complete audit trail. This course connects the Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Value for Money, rated criteria, and risk-based planning into a practical workflow. Through hands-on workshops, you will develop a PPSD summary, map activities in STEP, analyse markets, draft evaluation criteria, build a Microsoft Excel evaluation worksheet, and design a contract performance dashboard. You will learn to apply proportionate controls, preserve competition and integrity, and report contract progress clearly despite incomplete specifications, limited market data, tight schedules, and uneven digital readiness.
audienceIntro: This World Bank procurement training course is designed for professionals who plan, execute, review, or oversee procurement activities within Investment Project Financing operations.
modules: Standard Procurement Documents and Rated Criteria
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate course requires basic familiarity with procurement, project delivery, contract administration, or bid evaluation. Prior experience with World Bank-financed projects helps but remains optional. You need no coding or programming skills. Bring a laptop capable of running a spreadsheet application and, where organizational policy permits, anonymized examples of a procurement plan, solicitation document, or contract monitoring report.
